notes.title: V1.0 Launch Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Rogue Station 1.0 is out! Thanks to everyone who helped during early access and provided feedback.

As a small thank you, I set up the early access depots separately so the soundtrack can be included for free in the coming days. This will only apply to anyone who purchased before the 22nd of August 2023.

What to expect in the future? 

Updates are planned for a long time after the release. This is something I very much enjoy working on and, now that the game is released, I can focus on content.
Feedback and suggestions are always welcome and will keep guiding priorities going forward.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased end game difficulty growth.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed control issue with the new UI blocking movement on the right when a character was selected.
[*] Fixed a bug with enemy scaling using perks. The added perks would have 0 default values and added no extra difficulty.
[*] Fixed custom game issue with year length not being taken into account.
[*] Fixed a bug with enemy ships not loading their correct floor health.
[*] Fixed a bug after loading a saved game where future ships might spawn pre-damaged.
[*] Fixed issue with crew count on loaded ships.
[*] Fixed AI behavior where crew kept going back to the first room they appeared in instead of roaming around when set to go anywhere.
[*] Fixed AI behavior for Stay At Component crew after getting reborn. If someone had taken their spot, they would not return correctly to their assigned station.
[*] Visual fixes when destroying ships.
[*] Fixed issue where, after removing a selected character, the UI could become unresponsive.
[/list]

[h2]Misc:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Localization for a few extra languages has been added as options in settings. These translations are not supported and are not very good but, since they were included by error when the OS language matched and to avoid anyone losing previous functionality, they will be available to use as is.
[/list]

notes.title: V0.1.4 Hotfix and balancing
notes.notes:
[h1]V0.1.4[/h1]
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added rerolls to perk selection. You now start with 1 reroll and accrue 1 every 50 days.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed NullRef issues in pathfinder, Anti missile turret & lingering bombs.
[*] Fixed mobile station being out of the screen limits when spawning.
[*] Fixed boundary issues on very large resolutions.
[*] Fixed mercenary missions possibly stacking incorrectly causing a progression block.
[*] Fixed pause overlay being shown in combat and vice versa for combat.
[*] Fixed an annoying bug with the shield where it keeps turning off at 50% instead of 0.
[*] Fixed progression block when components got upgraded past their max level by error. This would also happen in later stages of the game for the enemy ships.
[*] Fixed enemy characters spawning in random locations instead of their current task. When an enemy ship appears, all crew will be in position ready to fight.
[*] Fixed an issue with the in game menu being open at the same time as other events, resuming the game while playing the events(such as the mercenary mission).
[/list]
[h2]Misc:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips to the upcoming UI elements.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]

[h3]Events:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Colony can now grow up to 10 levels (previously 5) with the cost of upgrading increasing faster than before. Once fully leveled the event then provides a large cash reward (end game).
[*] Mercenary missions now go up to lvl 10 (previously 5) with better reward. When playing the mission, your weapon will be a modified version of either the laser blaster or machine gun depending on which is higher level. At lvl 3 the weapon will not fire 2 projectiles and from lvl 6 2 additional ones in a slight V shape (In the next path this will be included in their upgrade tree).
[/list]
	
[h3]Characters:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced job bonus from 400% to 200%.
[*] Reduced previous job bonus from 200% to 150%.
[/list]



[h3]Ship:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgrade system rework: Upgrades are now in their own menu accessible either via the main screen or via a button when selecting a component.
[*] The new system has a small upgrade tree with different paths giving out different bonuses [INCOMPLETE]. For this update only the generator has actual path decisions, other systems will be shortly added but I didn’t want to delay the patch too much as ~20 systems X 6 special upgrades equals 120 modifiers with localization etc.
[*] Weapons balance: All weapons have been rebalanced (still Work in progress). First tier of weapons don’t scale to very high dps anymore and are more useful for their utility upgrades later on. 
[*] Increased health to keep up with DPS better. Floor tiles also have more health and give bigger health bonuses when upgraded.
[/list]
[h3]Oxygen:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Air leaks are now 5X larger than before. The max air loss for a breach is now 1000(up from 200) units or 50% of an open door flow.
[/list]
[h3]Fire:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fire ignition of nearby tiles increased to 0.2 (previously 0.1). That means if a fire is burning with 20 fire ranks, nearby tiles will get +4 ignition ranks per seconds (100 require to ignite).
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]V0.1.3[/h1]
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added WASD/Arrow movement in game.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed prog block when losing at the same time as an event is triggered.
[*] Fixed SFX overlap in mercenary missions.
[*] Fixed bug where life support getting damage on enemy ship was not cutting off oxygen.
[*] Fixed issue with tasks not being assigned correctly when assigning characters to larger components.
[*] Fixed issue where Rank perks are being offered for locked components.
[*] Fixed FTUX issue where the center enemy shortcut no longer works after the last tip.
[/list]

[h2]Misc:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed the delete button to sell.
[*] Added visual help for power cost before building components.
[*] Reworked power UI display on the status bar.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[h3]Characters:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Greatly increase character skill level up speed.
[/list]
[h3]Systems:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shields: Increased damage block.
[*] Shields: Reduced replenish per seconds gain when upgrading.
[*] Shields: Increased upgrade costs.
[*] Life Support: Change the system’s Operation Ratio from being linear to ease in expo. In short the system loses most of its effectiveness after only a small amount of damage (opposite of the generator). The goal is to make it easier to suffocate a ship and add more importance to life support/Oxygen management in general.
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Artillery: Reduced upgrade cost/time.
[*] Artillery: Increased accuracy a lot.
[*] Machine Gun: Increased fire rate.
[*] Buffed 2 Artillery perks.
[/list]
